questions.question: What is vocabulary?
questions.answer: The collection of words a person knows and uses.

questions.question: Learning new words improves communication skills.
Which word is a synonym of 'Happy'?
Fill in the blank: A word with the opposite meaning is called an ______.
What is a synonym?
questions.answer: A word that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another word.

questions.question: Observe the image and identify the object.
Which image represents learning vocabulary?
The word 'Ancient' means very old.
Fill in the blank: A dictionary helps us find the ______ of words.
Which word is an antonym of 'Strong'?
Why is vocabulary important?
questions.answer: It helps us understand, communicate, read, and write more effectively.

questions.question: Context clues help us understand unfamiliar words.
Observe the image and identify the learning resource.
Which image is commonly used to improve vocabulary?
Explain the difference between a synonym and an antonym.
questions.answer: A synonym has a similar meaning, while an antonym has the opposite meaning.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Reading books regularly helps improve your ______.
Which word best completes the sentence? 'The child was ______ after winning the competition.'
Vocabulary building is useful only for English exams.
What is one effective way to improve vocabulary?
questions.answer: Reading books, newspapers, and learning new words daily.

questions.question: Explain why using a variety of words improves communication.
questions.answer: It makes communication clearer, more interesting, and more precise.
